name: honeylog-cloudflare-worker
description: Send Honeylog pageview events from a Cloudflare site.

HONEYLOG_INGESTION_SECRET.description: Copy this secret from Honeylog. Keep it private.

HONEYLOG_API_KEY.description: Leave blank unless Honeylog gives you an API key.

HONEYLOG_SITE_DOMAIN.description: Enter your site domain, for example `example.com`.

HONEYLOG_SITE_SCHEME.description: Use `https` unless your site uses HTTP.

HONEYLOG_EVENT_NAME.description: Leave as `pageview` unless Honeylog tells you to change it.

HONEYLOG_SKIP_PATH_REGEX.description: Keep the default value unless Honeylog tells you to change it.

ORIGIN_URL.description: Leave blank unless Honeylog tells you to set a custom origin.
